title: NetFlow | Platform Health
description: Platform (ClickHouse), flow collection and exporters are shown separately. Platform tiles ignore the selection; collector and exporter tiles follow the site / device selection. No traffic is "no data", not an outage. Container state (inlet/outlet/Kafka) is available only via status.sh.

list.label: Data scope
list.query: Real only : real,Demo only : demo,Real + demo : all

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.description: Site = Zabbix host group "Site/<name>". All = every monitored host, including hosts without a site group.

list.name: device_group
list.label: Device type
list.description: Device type = Zabbix host group "Type/<name>" (router, switch, ...).

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.description: Devices of the selected site and type. Pick one or several to compare. New Zabbix hosts appear here automatically.

list.name: exporter
list.label: Exporter
list.query: SELECT arrayJoin([${device:singlequote}]) AS e UNION DISTINCT SELECT DISTINCT ExporterName AS e FROM default.flows_1h0m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND position('${site:csv}', '.*') > 0 AND position('${device_group:csv}', '.*') > 0 AND arraySort([${device:singlequote}]) = arraySort([${site_hosts:singlequote}]) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: FLOW COLLECTION

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(count() = 0, 0, max(TimeReceived) > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, 2, 1) FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')

panels.description: RECEIVING FLOWS: a flow record arrived in the last 5 minutes. IDLE: flows exist in the last 24 h but none recently. NO FLOW DATA: nothing in 24 h (expected in a lab without traffic, not an outage). Container-level state of inlet / outlet / Kafka: status.sh.

panels.title: LAST REAL FLOW AGE

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now())) AS age FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')

panels.description: Time since the newest flow record in the selected data scope (raw table, last 24 h). "No flows in 24 h" = nothing was received; it does not say a device is down.

panels.title: CLICKHOUSE
panels.description: The datasource answers queries. Platform health, independent of the selection and of traffic.

panels.title: CLICKHOUSE MEMORY

targets.rawSql: SELECT value FROM system.asynchronous_metrics WHERE metric = 'MemoryResident'

panels.description: Resident memory; container cap 3 GiB. Independent of the selection.

panels.title: DISK UTILIZATION

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * (total_space - free_space) / total_space, 1) FROM system.disks WHERE name = 'default'

panels.description: Data disk. Ingestion is frozen by disk-guard at 95 %. Independent of the selection.

panels.title: QUERY HEALTH (p95)

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms)) FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND user = 'grafana_ro' AND event_time > now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE

panels.description: p95 duration of Grafana queries in the last 15 minutes (limit is 30 s per query). Independent of the selection.

panels.title: CONFIGURED EXPORTERS

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(Inventory = 'Configured') FROM (SELECT l.exporter AS Exporter,
  multiIf(r.ex = '', 'NO DATA', x.ex != '', 'ACTIVE', 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') AS Status,
  if(has([${device:singlequote}], l.exporter), 'Configured', 'NOT IN INVENTORY') AS Inventory,
  if(x.ex != '', x.bps, 0) AS Traffic, if(x.ex != '', x.fps, 0) AS `Flows/s`, if(r.ex = '', NULL, if(x.ex != '', x.age, r.age)) AS `Last flow`
  FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([${exporter:singlequote}]) AS exporter) AS l
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS r ON l.exporter = r.ex
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/300 AS bps, count()/300 AS fps, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS x ON l.exporter = x.ex)

panels.title: Ingestion rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(60, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, count()/greatest(60, $__interval_s) AS fps
     FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Flow records per second (raw table, latest ≤24 h).

defaults.noValue: No flows in the selected range

panels.title: New flow data per hour

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfHour(modification_time) AS time, sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes FROM system.parts
     WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table = 'flows' AND $__timeFilter(modification_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Approximation from part modification time (merges rewrite parts).

defaults.noValue: No new flow data in the selected range

panels.title: Exporter freshness

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Exporter, Status, Inventory, Traffic, `Flows/s`, `Last flow` FROM (SELECT l.exporter AS Exporter,
  multiIf(r.ex = '', 'NO DATA', x.ex != '', 'ACTIVE', 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') AS Status,
  if(has([${device:singlequote}], l.exporter), 'Configured', 'NOT IN INVENTORY') AS Inventory,
  if(x.ex != '', x.bps, 0) AS Traffic, if(x.ex != '', x.fps, 0) AS `Flows/s`, if(r.ex = '', NULL, if(x.ex != '', x.age, r.age)) AS `Last flow`
  FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([${exporter:singlequote}]) AS exporter) AS l
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS r ON l.exporter = r.ex
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/300 AS bps, count()/300 AS fps, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS x ON l.exporter = x.ex)
   ORDER BY multiIf(Status = 'ACTIVE', 0, Status = 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS', 1, 2), Exporter

panels.description: Rows = devices configured in Zabbix for the selected scope plus any exporter seen in flows. ACTIVE: flows in the last 5 min. IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS: seen in the last 7 days but quiet. NO DATA: configured but no flow seen in 7 days — this says nothing about the device being up or down (see Device Health). NOT IN INVENTORY: sends flows but is not a Zabbix host. Traffic and flows/s are 5-minute averages.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT table AS Table, sum(bytes_on_disk) AS Size, round(100*sum(bytes_on_disk)/sum(sum(bytes_on_disk)) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM system.parts
     WHERE active AND database = 'default' GROUP BY table ORDER BY Size DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms) AS p95, max(query_duration_ms) AS max
     FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND user = 'grafana_ro' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
